name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.4-beta

- TV app phase 2, step 1: anime from your extensions on the TV, PC as a source, Flutter test apps
  - The TV's streams list for anime also asks your phone (or PC) for the servers of your anime extensions; the TV plays them in its own player, with the video passed through the phone/PC so the site gets the headers it needs.
  - New pass-through (lib/plus/tv/tv_proxy.dart) fixes the old "format not supported": HLS playlists given straight away had their segments treated as playlists; audio groups, keys and init parts weren't passed through; links without .m3u8 weren't seen as HLS. Video hidden behind picture bytes is cut loose for the TV.
  - Anime that Stremio addons don't know open by their AniList id, with the episode list from the extension.
  - Episodes watched this way go to AniList.
  - Windows: AnymeX+ is a source for the TV whenever it's open (TV Remote page switch). The TV remembers every device that connected and tries the next one when the current one is away. A PC leaves the sync from your phone alone.
  - LG TVs are found on the network from a PC.
  - tv_flutter/: two small Flutter test apps (plain screen; screen with video) built with LG's flutter-webOS SDK by a separate workflow and published for Homebrew Channel.
